player_prompt.intro:
Wena Mdlali {player_id} ({piece}). Mdlali wesibhamu ngu ({opp}).
Ngcisha imikhambi njengo '[a2 a3]' (ku → ku).
- Likhamba lelisaphila lilikhamba liphakame lisaphila elihle kakhulu kuindlela eyahlukene.
- Ukucopha kwindlela ekhuluma ngalo ukuphinda phezulu komdlali wesibhamu odlule kuindlela eyahlukene.
Ukucopha kwindlela kunika {score_per_capture} iphoyinti.
Emdlwengweni ihlala emva kwemikhambi {max_moves} noma lapho mdlali angena naliphi na ilikhamba eliseduze.
